project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

storage_location.description:
Policy of which storage location is going to be resolved, and additional data
that particularizes how the policy is going to be carried out

storage_location.policy.description: The chosen location policy Possible values: ["NEAREST_MULTI_REGION", "LOCAL_REGION", "SPECIFIC_LOCATIONS"]

storage_location.locations.description:
When the policy is SPECIFIC_LOCATIONS, snapshots will be stored in the
locations listed in this field. Keys are Cloud Storage bucket locations.
Only one location can be specified.

storage_location.locations.location.description: The identifier for this object. Format specified above.

storage_location.locations.name.description:
Name of the location. It should be one of the Cloud Storage buckets.
Only one location can be specified. (should match location)
